stage.name: Battle! Blazin' Soul of a Warrior!
stage.description:
I will extinguish the flames with my own hands. Let's finish this.
No melee/ranged deployment restrictions on this stage

oxmane.name: Oxmane
oxmane.flavourText: A carnivore common to the mountains that hunts primarily in packs. Bearing developed mandibles, they crush their prey's skulls with ease. Most fond of feeding on hornbeast stragglers.

chitotex_clawbeast.name: Chitotex Clawbeast
chitotex_clawbeast.flavourText: An herbivore that dwells by cliffsides, their front claws equipped for digging out rock faces. They grow rear shells hard enough to withstand falling stones, but bear unusually soft bellies. Their delicious meat is the primary cause of their falling population.
abilities: Weak spot located on its front, damage dealt to the rear is significantly decreased

basorobeast.name: Basorobeast
basorobeast.flavourText: An herbivore that dwells by cliffsides. The protective boulders that crown their heads are, in fact, the secretions of a symbiotic organism. Some have witnessed Basorobeasts battling Chitotex Clawbeasts in turf wars.
abilities: Weak spot located on its rear, damage dealt to the front is significantly decreased

rathalos.name: Rathalos
rathalos.flavourText: The crimson-carapaced, flame-commanding Rathalos, its capacity for flight excels among Flying Wyverns, its aerial assaults and flaming breath combine to dominate over a vast array of life. Owing to the astonishing strength by which it rules the air, it is also known as the 'King of the Skies.'
abilities: Can only be blocked by Operators with 3 or more Block
The Rathalos's tail can be severed by attacking it from behind in its Grounded State
[Roar] Stuns all allied units on the field
[Tailspin] Deals Physical damage in a semicircle to the rear to all targets
[Fire Breath] Deals Arts damage to allied units
[Backfire] Deals Arts damage to targets in front and takes flight
Flash Grenades can knock the Rathalos out of its Flying State
[Aerial Claw Attack] Deals Physical damage in a circle to surrounding targets
[Aerial Heat Breath] Breathes fire in a fan shape, dealing Arts damage to targets in front
[Rushing Fire Breath] Breathes a column of flames, dealing Arts damage to all targets within 3 rows in front
[Nest] If it is not defeated in the first wave, it will move into its Den
